name: Arisugawa Dice
source:
A lawless gambler, who constantly puts his life on the line. Always looking for the next thrill, he gambles away all his money and constantly goes into debt. With no fixed address, he’s always penniless and starving. 

[spoiler]Though estranged from his mother, Otome, he offered to make a deal with her in order to keep Ramuda safe.
